card.name: Early words in titles and parentheticals
card.fires_on: Short words just after a colon in a book title, or the digit 1 in a section cross-reference like (17). It also fires on scattered small words in running text.

modes.label: Book subtitle starts
modes.description: The first word of a subtitle after a colon in a bibliography entry.

modes.label: Section cross-reference
modes.description: The digit 1 opening the number 17 in a Patient Counseling Information cross-reference.

modes.label: Scattered small words
modes.description: Short words in running prose, such as be, non, likes or too, where the next piece continues a phrase.
modes.example: life would<< be>> like a long vacation.

card.plain: It fires on the opening word of a book subtitle and on the first digit of a label cross-reference. It has no single clear theme.
